blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
exercises.why: Note that the feminine gender is used: одна вторая, две седьмых, etc. — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Note that the feminine gender is used: одна вторая, две седьмых, etc.

exercises.prompt: September is the ninth month of the year.
exercises.why: A noun or a numeral which follows this word is in the Dative case: *Шесть плюс три равно девяти. Эта скорость равна скорости звука.* Note also: *Мне всё равно.* — I don't care (It's all the same to me). — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: A noun or a numeral which follows this word is in the Dative case: *Шесть плюс три равно девяти.

exercises.q: На УЗИ можно что-то разглядеть не раньше ___ (шестой) недели.
exercises.prompt: You can't see anything in the scans until after 5 weeks.
exercises.why: «Сколько» and «несколько» are declined like Adjectives in the plural: *На скольких самолётах есть радары? — Не знаю точно, но на нескольких есть.* — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: «Сколько» and «несколько» are declined like Adjectives in the plural: *На скольких самолётах есть радары? — Не знаю точно, но на нескольких есть.

exercises.prompt: John the Baptist was the first Baptist.
exercises.why: Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural.

exercises.prompt: I'll be there on the fourth.
exercises.why: The first part is in the Genitive case: пятидесятый, двухсотый. — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The first part is in the Genitive case: пятидесятый, двухсотый.
